utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Leo — I’m just quietly asking around for the repair drive, mostly to see if anyone has tool kits they could lend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli — if I can spare my kit, I’ll let you know. I’ll check tonight and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. No rush — even knowing by tomorrow would help me pass the word along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Kira, I can’t call Saturday definite until Rosa and I confirm the final time, but yes, for now we’re only focusing on safety repair supplies like railings, lighting, and leaks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Cleo—so I’ll tell folks it’s this weekend but not lock in Saturday yet, and that we’re only collecting safety repair supplies for now until you confirm the final list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Exactly, Kira—please keep it to “this weekend, time still being confirmed,” and safety repair supplies only for now. I’ll send the final list once Rosa and I finish checking the closet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just let me know the main details and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — it’s now Sunday at the community center, and if you can bring any basic tools or spare hardware, that would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my basic tools and see if I have any spare hardware too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ve got Saturday the 18th, nine to noon penciled in, and I’m finishing the repair list now. Once I confirm Sam and Lila’s jobs, I’ll tell you plainly where we still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — that sounds clear. Send me the confirmed job list and any gaps, and I’ll double-check the details before we tell everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Hana. I’ll send the confirmed list and any gaps as soon as I finish checking Sam and Lila’s jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — that’s a big help. I’ll keep lining up the table setup and a couple more repair volunteers, and I’ll confirm anything new as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Mara — keep me posted on the table setup and any new volunteers, and I’ll keep tracking the pickups and timing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Opal — I’ll check on tables next and let you know as soon as I’ve got setup and any extra repair hands confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Oren, what do you need from me for the repair drive? Just give me the main details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — sorry, I keep losing track. Mostly just bring whatever tools you’ve got, and I’ll point you to what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring my tools. Just point me to the main fixes when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ira, sounds like extension cords, work gloves, labeled parts bins, and basic hand tools are still useful—since I’ll likely be late, I can bring whichever of those you think will help most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — work gloves and basic hand tools would help the most if you can bring those.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll bring work gloves and a few basic hand tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — what still needs fixing, and do you have a date set yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I don’t have the date locked yet — Cleo’s still confirming the time and supply needs for the repair drive, and I’ll pass along the details as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you tell me what supplies Cleo still needs, and I’ll keep the list moving?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Jules, do you know what time people are meant to start dropping things off? I just worry the first rush could clog up the room before Leo gets the tables sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think Hana was going to double-check the start time, so I don’t want to guess, but your concern makes sense. I can nudge her and also ask Leo if he wants a couple of us there early to keep the doorway clear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be really helpful, thanks. If someone can confirm the start time and keep the doorway clear, it should go a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, Tess—do you know if they’ve settled on a date or the repair list yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard a firm date yet, Nell, just that folks are lining up lamps, toasters, and little wobbly things to fix. I’m asking around today about the list and whether they still need extra tables or tool kits.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — that helps. I’ll wait on the firm date and confirmed repair list before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still catching up on the repair drive. Tell me what’s broken and when you need help, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — we’re aiming for Saturday late morning into early afternoon, but I’m still waiting on the final start time and tools list. If you can help with repairs during that window, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday late morning to early afternoon should work for me. Just send the final start time and tools list when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still putting that list together. Once I’ve got it, I’ll send it over and let you know if I need any help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll set aside Saturday to bring whatever tools I can and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. I’ll get that list wrapped up and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane — I’m pulling the repair drive list together now. What’s broken, and when would you be free to help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa — I can help, but I’ll probably arrive late; can you put me down for whatever still needs hands then, and let me know what tools or supplies to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Dane — I’ll put you down as a late-arrival helper for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send you the tools list once I match up the repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I’m catching up on the repair drive—can you give me the quick version: is it definitely this Saturday, what items are accepted, and do you need me on sign-ups or pickups?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s this Saturday morning. I’m still confirming the accepted items with Rosa, and I can help with pickups if that’s what you need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—please confirm the accepted items with Rosa and send me the short list, and I’ll start lining up sign-ups while you cover pickups.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell — if you need tools or an extra pair of hands for the repair drive, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’m still waiting on confirmed dates and the needs list, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear something solid.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell — once you get the date and list, just send them my way and I’ll see what I can bring from the garage.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We still need help with the fence, a leaky gutter, and the broken front step. Sam and Lila are in, and I’m still trying to line up one more person.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s helpful, Ira—let’s put Sam and Lila on the fence for now, and I’ll add the gutter and front step to the list while you check on one more helper.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Eli—thanks for sorting that. I’ll keep checking for one more helper while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hi Faye—before I tell people anything firm, can you confirm if the repair drive is definitely Saturday and whether we’re only taking safety repair supplies for now?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday sounds like the plan, and yes, let’s keep it to safety repair supplies for now until we confirm the full list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll wait to tell people it’s definite until you confirm the time. Please send the full list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the time, so I can’t call Saturday definite yet. For now, please focus on safety repair supplies, and I’ll share the final tool list once I finish the closet count.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo—I'll hold off on calling Saturday definite and focus on the safety supplies for now. Once Rosa confirms the time and you finish the closet count, I’ll help make sure we’ve got enough tables and space planned.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Pia—tables and space will be a big help once we know the time. I’ll ping you as soon as Rosa confirms and I’ve got the closet count finished.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can’t promise much, Sam, but I’ll keep the flyer with me and mention it to anyone who asks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s perfect, Uli — even just having the flyer handy helps. If anyone asks for details, send them my way and I’ll fill them in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that, Sam. I’ll point folks to you if they need more than what’s on the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Opal! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Mara’s lining up setup and volunteers, and we’d love for you to come or pass the invite along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — could you keep an eye out for which homes on your block still need help and which are already covered? That’ll help me keep the pickup list accurate.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll check my block and let you know which homes still need help and which are covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, do you know if Ira still needs that extra helper, and are we short on folding tables or tool kits?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard the latest from Ira yet, but Opal’s still sorting the stations, so I can check with them and loop you in. Last I heard, Hana was double-checking what tools to bring, so I’m not sure yet whether tables or tool kits are the bigger gap.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please check with Ira and Opal today, then tell me which is short: tables, tool kits, or that extra hose-fitting helper.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Tess — we’re aiming for Saturday late morning into early afternoon for the repair drive. If you’re free, I could really use help with setup or a repair station.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Mara, Saturday late morning works for me—I can come help with setup, and I’m already asking around about extra folding tables and tool kits too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s fantastic, Tess—thank you. If you can keep asking, I’ll keep lining up the setup and a couple more repair volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still trying to get the repair drive straight, Noah. Do you know what’s actually broken or who has the list?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still waiting on Leo for the address and list, so I don’t have the full details yet. Once I get it straight, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah. I’ll wait for your word, then—I’m happy to help once the list and address are clear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Oren — I’m just confirming the repair drive start time and tool list now, so I’ll pass along only what’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana — that helps a lot. If you send me the definite time and what tools to bring, I’ll set them by the door so I don’t forget.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely, Oren — I’ll send you the confirmed start time and tool list as soon as I’ve checked them, so you can set out only what’s needed.
